facts.fact: Proptech platform Nawy secured $75 million in total financing in May 2025: a $52 million Series A equity round led by Partech and Shorooq, described as international VC firms (TechCabal).
Nawy received a $24 million debt facility from the National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr, part of its May 2025 $75 million financing, per TechCabal.
Egyptian banks, the National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr, provided Nawy a $24 million debt facility in May 2025 to finance its mortgage offering, per TechCabal.
Wealthtech platform Thndr raised $15.7 million in May 2025 in a round led by Prosus Ventures (TechCabal).
MoneyFellows, a digital rotating-savings platform, closed a $13 million pre-Series C round in May 2025 (TechCabal; investors not named).
Automotive technology company Sylndr secured a $15.7 million Series A equity round in May 2025 (TechCabal; investors not named).

note: Egypt Startup Charter and its EGP 50bn fund are government pledges (other); Rology undisclosed amount; InfiniLink is an acquisition exit with no named investment amount.
